# folk | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence position | Collaborative relationship CRM, integrating contacts, mailboxes, calendars, WhatsApp and LinkedIn workflows into flexible conduits. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition boundary | Complex forecasts, CPQ and service management capacity are weaker than enterprise packages; contacts are rich, news, and AI fields may be restricted by credits. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Complex forecasting, CPQ and service management capabilities are weaker than Enterprise Suite; contact rich, messaging, AI fields can all be limited by credits. |
